thread:
olivia: Promo stalled for chart redwood-inference/ai-ingress v2.3.1 -> staging. Deploy-bot shows node-drain timeout on two staging nodes and a postupgrade job stuck. Anyone seeing this?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: node-drain-timeout(2/3), postupgrade-job 'migrate-nightly' Pending -> CrashLoopBackOff. logs available. action: hold.

raj: is that job the DB migration or a lightweight config job?

olivia: it's the nightly migration job that touches /data on the shared PVC. CrashLoop shows permission denied writing to /data. suspect values overlay change.

emily: that matches the overlay change from yesterday — we flipped values.staging.enableLegacyPvc -> false to switch to ephemeral volume for tests. migration job still expects legacy PVC.

gwen: ah ok. we removed the pvc overlay to avoid quota blowup. quick question: can we skip the migrate job for this release and promote, or do we need to pin back to v2.3.0?

olivia: options: 1) patch the canary to set postupgrade.skipMigrate=true and re-promote (fast, but migration won't run), 2) pin staging to previous chart 2.3.0 and abort promote, 3) fix overlay in staging (add back legacy PVC) and retry (takes PR + merge).

raj: for prod we should avoid skipping migrations. prefer pin for now and queue a hotfix to re-run migrations after PVC change.

emily: I can open the PR to restore the pvc overlay for staging; ETA ~30m. but that won't help the current promo; pin seems safest.

gwen: agree with pin -> release notes should call out migration deferred and hotfix window. I'll start a release-notes fragment.

olivia: ok i'm going to abort promote and pin staging to 2.3.0. tagging the chart and annotating release. @deploy-bot can you record the manual pin reason?

deploy-bot: action=manual_pin, user=olivia, reason="staging postupgrade job CrashLoop due to pvc overlay removal", pinned_version=2.3.0, timestamp=1739876552

olivia: commands i ran (for audit):

```
# abort current promotion
kubectl -n deploybot logs job/deploy-promote-17398765 --tail=200
kubectl -n staging rollout undo deployment/ai-ingress --to-revision=2 # revert to chart 2.3.0 tag
helm history ai-ingress -n staging
# annotate release
kubectl -n releases annotate release ai-ingress promoted-by=olivia manual-pin-reason="staging migration failed"
```

raj: thanks. emily, please link the PR to the pinned release and add the migration plan.

emily: will do. opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/482 — adds pvc overlay back for staging and a conditional check in the migration job.

gwen: drafting release note snippet: "Promotion to v2.3.1 deferred for staging due to postupgrade migration job failure; pinned to v2.3.0. Hotfix & migration window scheduled Thu 10:00 UTC." adding to notes doc.

olivia: filing the rollback/ pin entry in the release tracker and scheduling hotfix. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
